Ninth Woman Found Murdered in South Africa, Serial Killer Fears Rise

South African authorities are investigating the murders of nine women, with fears growing that a serial killer may be responsible. The latest victim was discovered recently, bringing the total to nine. The discovery has sent shockwaves across the country. Police have not yet made any arrests or identified suspects in connection with the killings. The ongoing investigations are focused on determining if a single perpetrator is behind the series of deaths.
